_name: Your language name (in that language), e.g. Српски
_help: Copy this file to lang/xx.json (xx = language code, e.g. sr, hu, sv, pt-BR), translate the values (keep {placeholders} like {n}, {pct}, {v}, {menu} unchanged), set _name, restart the program. Keys that are missing fall back to English. Files starting with _ are ignored.
d_hint: Enter the DPI for each of the 6 stages of the mouse DPI button.
d_err_range: Stage {n}: the value must be from 1 to 100000.
d_err_write: Could not write dpi.txt (is the folder write-protected?).
cfg_comment:
DPI values for the DPI button stages.
Edit them via the app menu: "{menu}".
Format: stage_number = DPI
